paragraphs.text: Who were a people that came from Magog the son of Japheth, Ge 10:2. Magog also here signifies a certain country so that by these two countries which had the government of Greece and Italy he means the principal enemies of the Church, Re 20:8.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: He shows that the enemy would bend themselves against the Church but it would be to their own destruction.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: The Persians, Ethiopians and men of Africa.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Gomer was Japheth's son, and Togarmah the son of Gomer, and are thought to be they that inhabited Asia Minor.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Signifying that all the people of the world would assemble themselves against the Church and Christ their head.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: That is, to molest and destroy the Church.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: Meaning Israel, which had now been destroyed and was not yet built again: declaring by this the simplicity of the godly, who seek not so much to fortify themselves by outward force, as to depend on the providence and goodness of God.

paragraphs.text: Signifying that God will be sanctified by maintaining his church, and destroying his enemies, as in Eze 36:23,37:28.

paragraphs.text: By this he declares that no affliction can come to the Church of which they have not been advertised before to teach them to endure all things with more patience when they know that God has so ordained.
